samples.comment: Too much AI, no phone number, delay in AI generated responses. I just want help from a live person over the phone to fix the connection issue

Passed from. One AI bot to another
 Very frustrating PLUS 2 days between each exchange of emails
I am waiting the demand, thanks

It would nice to get a response from a person not a trite AI that simply plays back what I said. 

I won’t be buying any more of your products, you don’t support them and request for improvement is met with indifference.

I am disappointed with the support I received. I contacted Positive Grid to ask whether full Spanish support for the Spark app and Spark AI is planned. Instead of addressing my question, I only received a response stating that the feature is currently available in English.

That does not answer my question or provide any useful information about future plans. Spanish is one of the most widely spoken languages in the world, and I expected a more informative and customer-focused response.

I hope Positive Grid improves both its customer support and its commitment to multilingual use
You guys - or I mean you bots - are...what's the word for beyond lame? Let's go with ragingly pathetic
Very inefficient.  I’ve twice sent emails about my order only to be replied that my order can’t be found even though I’ve sent a screenshot of my order.  Need real people instead of bots.

In particular I am still not convinced that I can hold a button on the back, press and hold a button on the front, plug a cable without releasing both and take a photo of the process all by myself :-)
I have been sent two replacement units for my faulty Spark Go, which I had to pay for, and both have been dead on arrival. I am considering taking legal action.

I was trying to buy Spark NEO from the website and the price was showing as $249. When I tried to checkout the price keeps changing to $419. I have tried to contact your customer support and they didn’t resolve the issue for me as they said the correct price is $419.

The response did not fully address the issue I described.

I had already explained that BIAS MINI BASS does not appear as an option under “Register Your Product,” which prevents me from following the standard registration procedure. However, I was only referred to the general registration guide, without any explanation of how to resolve this specific issue.

I would appreciate it if support could review the details of my case, including my previous deactivation request under ticket #457658, and provide instructions for re-registering the device.

I have asked about a possibility to directly set the volume of the loop on my spark 2 without using the app. The advise was basically to rather adjust the volume of my guitar to have a proper balance. This does not so if the problem of setting an overall volume which may be necessary example given enclosed rooms in a rented flat with neighbors are playing at night or on the other hand on the street where I only have my amp and not my phone and want to raise the volume of the loop to have an overall good loudness. I think this is a real design flaw to require the app to set this volume on the device. Please correct this

I had been trying to resolve weird tones and sounds on my Spark 2 since 30/08/26. Stupid requests from support for videos of how my headphones sound and do they sound like the loudspeakers. It’s very hard to play electric guitar when all the tones are awful and to show on video. I started out with Devin, your AI rep and after about a week got put through to Ryan, not sure if he’s AI or human. I am so disappointed with you, Positive Grid that I have now deregistered all my gear and closed my account as the warranty is non existent no matter what you do to get help. I am now using my old Line 6 amp with no problems so it is not my equipment that was at fault. I can’t do anything with my Spark 2 except recycle it and bite the bullet that I have got a dud unit that you won’t or can’t help me with. You have lost a customer and I will let my friends and colleagues know what it’s like dealing with you.

Hi, Ray Lanigan here. 
Although I absolutely love the positive grid products, and especially that I have already purchased different products from positive grid  also, I find it quite frustrating, that when I enquired about an artist endorsement, it's taken me quite a long time to hear anything back about my enquiry,  so much so, that I have had to resend my request on numerous occasions with still no response or answer. Because I am complaining somewhat about this,  I expect that if I do hear back now. It will probably be a negative response on my request,  and if that's the case, we'll so be it. I thought I would have been an idea candidate to promote the new 100-watt Reactor amplifier's because of the many Visions Of Floyd shows I do and are so active on social media to promote the positive grid brand. I hope to hear back from you soon with your decision, 
Yours kindly, 
Ray Lanigan.  (Visions Of Floyd)

I am not sure I have gotten what I want. I rank there is a solution with your products. The responses seem to be ai generated and I think may be right but I think a live person would have done better at least on my follow up. Regardless I made a purchase and will be trying your product out which I am excited for!

Devin, your AI agent, behaves reasonably human and for the first exchanges I was unaware I was working with AI.   HOWEVER, there were volleys for additional information that were unnecessary and the hand off to human support was clumsy, to the point where I was expecting an RMA and shipping label but the processes dropped back a step and I had to force re-engagement.  Those cost time and lost confidence.  Elanaor was fine once she was directly engaged.  I'd suggest revewing the history here and seeing what you can do to smooth out the support process.

Would prefer to communicate with a real person instead of Ai.
Registration of the product should be all that is needed to prove purchase/ownership.

I am now running my Spark 2 from a dedicated IPad as it was making odd noises on my main iPad. I have been trying to get some kind of warranty return for my equipment but it’s non existent in real terms. Registering your gear is a waste of time, so much so so that I have registered all of it and closed my account with you. It must be 3 months now that I have been messing about with spark 2. Checking  guitar wiring and leads. I lost all my Dropbox tones and had to start again. It bad enough trying to play a guitar without all this nonsense! You should release an update that will iron out all these bugs. I updated the firmware using a usb cable rather that OTA. That seemed to help. I won’t be buying anything else from PG.

Almost a week later, and after several attempts to get customer service to respond, I get an apology. That’s it.

I had to search for a way to change my email since there was no simple way to do so after logging into my account.  After finally finding out that I had to create a NEW account I had to notify positive grid of my need to transfer my account info.  This complicated, time consuming process, should be changed.  There should be a simple way to change an email when it's necessary.

The Neo arrived with a transmitter in which the power button was stuck. I couldn't fill out your online support forms because they required serial # and firmware# neither of which was labeled on the packaging! Talk about wasting time jumping through hoops. Finally found an email address for PG and got a quick, nice reply from AI agent. I tried everything that your AI agent suggested, nothing worked, it's just plain stuck. AI told me since it had arrived DOA, the situation would be turned over to a human agent and you'd be sending a replacement transmitter . . .Great! Except then the human said sorry, can't do that, deal with Amazon . .  so I did, sent it back. I wasted between 3- 4 hours of my time on this. I would have waited for and accepted a replacement transmitter, but at this point I'm done.
